reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need the order and refund data so I can check the handoff against the ledger.
I have the orders but still need the refund ledger to cross-check W2's handoff before any payout is recorded.
The refund handoff matches the ledger exactly for orders 211, 213, and 214, so I can proceed. I'll get each customer's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 48125 matches my check: orders 210 and 213 total 63258, less the 15133 refund on 213. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 54597 matches my check: orders 211 and 214 total 73966, less refunds of 12701 and 6668. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt's net of 46961 matches orders 212 and 215 (32516 + 14445) with no refunds, so all three balances check out against the ledger. I'll record the first payout, to acme for 48125.
Acme's payout is recorded and matches the ledger. Birch's net of 54597 matches orders 211 and 214 less refunds 12701 and 6668, so I'll record that payout next.
Cobalt's net of 46961 matches orders 212 and 215 (32516 + 14445) with no refunds, and I already verified it against the ledger. I'll record the last payout.
All three payouts were recorded and each matched my independent check against the orders and refunds ledger. The batch is complete.
